stage_info.name: optimization
stage_info.description: Box size optimization stage: Optimize box size/diameter for 3D reconstruction and heterogeneous refinement

optimization.heterogeneous_refinement_max_iterations_: Maximum number of K values to test for heterogeneous refinement (default: 3)
optimization.enable_multi_round_3d_classification_des: Enable multi-round 3D classification optimization (default: false). This should be done AFTER heterogeneous refinement and box size optimization.
optimization.multi_round_3d_classification_num_classe: Number of classes for 3D classification in each round (default: 4)
optimization.multi_round_3d_classification_max_rounds: Maximum number of rounds to run (default: 5)
optimization.multi_round_3d_classification_improvemen: Minimum improvement in resolution (Å) to continue to next round (default: 0.1)
optimization.ab_initio_initial_resolution_description: Initial resolution (Å) for ab initio reconstruction in optimization steps (default: 9.0)
optimization.ab_initio_final_resolution_description: Final/maximum resolution (Å) for ab initio reconstruction in optimization steps (default: 7.0)
optimization.use_nonuniform_refinement_description: Use non-uniform refinement (nonuniform_refine_new) instead of homogeneous refinement (homo_refine_new) for resolution verification (default: true)
optimization.refine_res_init_description: Initial lowpass resolution (Å) for refinement. Empirically, increasing this resolution (e.g., to a lower numerical value such as 15Å) may improve results for smaller targets. If null, uses CryoSPARC default (typically 30Å).
